title: Theo's tech bro purity test: Product Hunt skepticism and small habits
summary: A comedic checklist video with almost no business content. The only durable takes are that Product Hunt is a poor place to find customers because its audience is other marketers, that the YC YouTube channel is worth watching, and that Theo keeps a daily written log of what he did.

principles.text: Don't market a product in a space where everyone else is also marketing products; go where your actual users are.
principles.quote: imagine going to a react conference to Showcase a new lesson for react like you just made a new way for beginner devs to learn react the worst place to Market that is a conference for people who already know react

principles.text: Product Hunt's audience is other marketers studying launches, not buyers, so it is a weak distribution channel.
principles.quote: nobody actually finds new products on product hunt they're going there to look at how other companies are marketing

principles.text: The YC YouTube channel is a high-value free resource for understanding how startups work, even if you never run a company.
principles.quote: the YC YouTube channel is phenomenal and if you are interested in entrepreneur stuff even if you don't want to run a company just want to understand it better their channel is so good

principles.text: Keep a daily written log of what you did, as a lightweight personal retro.
principles.quote: I do have a dock that I've been maintaining for over a year now where at the end of every day I write what I did that day
